message.content:
It sounds like you’re ready to start shopping! Just to make sure I’m helping with the right step—do you actually want to **sign in** (so you can access your account) or do you already have a session open and simply wish to **log out**?

If it’s the former, let me know and I’ll handle the login process for you. If it’s the latter, there’s usually a “Log Out” button somewhere on the site – no need to enter your password again. Let me know how you'd like to proceed!
